2609.06581.title: Reading Decoder Trajectories: Training-Free Counterfactual Query-Trajectory Reliability for Small-Object Detection
2609.06581.paper_summary: Small-object detection remains challenging because limited pixels cause information loss and suppress the scale knowledge encoded in pretrained detectors. Existing approaches mainly improve representations through multiscale training, architecture redesign, or parameter adaptation, implicitly assuming that frozen models lack the required capability. We challenge this assumption and hypothesize that small-object knowledge already exists in frozen detectors but remains underactivated and unstable during query evolution. To test this hypothesis, we propose Counterfactual Query-Trajectory Reliability (CQTR), a training-free framework that elicits latent responses through counterfactual scale interventions and interprets candidate reliability from decoder-internal spatial convergence, semantic persistence, and cross-scale conflicts. A small unlabeled training subset selects the appropriate correction mechanism for each model-data stream, without parameter updates or target-domain annotations. Across 27 combinations of nine frozen detectors and three datasets, CQTR consistently improves average precision (AP) and average precision for small objects (APs). Closed-loop analyses further show that scale intervention activates latent responses, trajectory evidence predicts ground-truth support, and unlabeled routing selects the more effective branch. CQTR therefore reframes small-object detection from external scale augmentation to the activation and reliability assessment of latent scale knowledge.
2609.06581.paper_summary_zh: 小物體檢測仍然具有挑戰性，因為有限的像素會導致信息損失，並抑制預訓練檢測器中編碼的尺度知識。現有的方法主要通過多尺度訓練、架構重設或參數適應來改善表示，隱含地假設凍結的模型缺乏所需的能力。我們挑戰這一假設，並假設小物體知識已經存在於凍結的檢測器中，但在查詢演變過程中仍然未被激活且不穩定。為了驗證這一假設，我們提出了反事實查詢軌跡可靠性（CQTR），這是一個無需訓練的框架，通過反事實尺度干預引出潛在反應，並從解碼器內部的空間收斂、語義持久性和跨尺度衝突中解釋候選可靠性。一個小的未標記訓練子集為每個模型數據流選擇適當的修正機制，而無需參數更新或目標領域標註。在九個凍結檢測器和三個數據集的27種組合中，CQTR 始終提高了平均精度（AP）和小物體的平均精度（APs）。閉環分析進一步顯示，尺度干預激活了潛在反應，軌跡證據預測了真實支持，而未標記路由選擇了更有效的分支。因此，CQTR 將小物體檢測從外部尺度增強重新框架為潛在尺度知識的激活和可靠性評估。
